sourceFamily: Wikipedia country and regional museum lists
method: Names, locations, and type labels extracted from list tables and bullet lists; deduplicated by article URL or normalized name within a country. No source descriptions or images copied. Imported venues have not been individually checked for current operation or museum status. Missing fields remain unknown. English-language list coverage is uneven.
